_comment: Colour language of state_ownership.png. reserved = water (sea+lakes), unowned land, out-of-scope placeholder land, thin state-border line. tags = every start tag of planning/tag_registry.md (formables own nothing at start and are omitted). color = the tag's colour in common/country_definitions/ where one exists; 'nudged_from' marks a colour moved (CIELAB dE76 < 6 to another entry, or < 10 to a neighbouring owner); 'proposed': true marks a tag with no country definition yet (colour picked from a region hue family, dE >= 6 from every other entry). Every colour is unique. Hand-authored input: edit deliberately, then re-read the PNG.
